explanation: Most jumpers then used the straddle, rolling over face down. Soft foam landing mats made Fosbury's back-first 'flop' safe, and within about a decade it was the standard style.

claims.text: Dick Fosbury won the high jump at the 1968 Mexico City Olympics using a back-first technique.
Fosbury did not win the pole vault, long jump or hurdles in 1968.
In the 1960s most high jumpers used the straddle technique, crossing the bar face down.
Soft foam landing mats made landing on the back and shoulders safe.
Within about a decade of 1968 the Fosbury Flop had become the standard high jump technique.
